tagline: Yɛyɛ kwan a ɛda nokware nimdeɛ ne adwumayɛ akwan ntam

country.pickerSubtitle: Unmapped Kairos bɛsesa ne ho ama wo adwuma akwan, sukuu nhyehyɛeɛ, sika, ne kasa. Yi baabi a wote.

intake.title: Ka deɛ wotumi yɛ kyerɛ yɛn
intake.subtitle: Wo nimdeɛ wɔ hɔ, sɛ obi twerɛɛ no anaa ɛnyɛ. Yɛbɛboa wo ama wode atwerɛ — na wo ara na wokyerɛ asɛm biara.
intake.educationPrompt: Sukuu beberee a wodii ɛyɛ deɛn?
intake.credentialPrompt: Wonyaa krataa anaa diploma pɔtee bi?
intake.languagesPrompt: Kasa bɛn na wotumi de yɛ adwuma?
intake.experiencePrompt: Ka nneɛma a wotumi yɛ — adwuma a woayɛ agye sika, nneɛma a wo ara woasua, anaa nnwuma a woayɛ.
intake.experiencePlaceholder: Sɛ: M'asiesie phone mfeɛ 5. Mesuaa Python firi YouTube. Mewɔ WhatsApp dwadie ketewa bi.

profile.title: Wo profile
profile.subtitle: Yei yɛ wo dea. Sesa biribiara a ɛnte sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Tu ho yi sɛ JSON passport a wode bɛkɔ baabiara.

readiness.title: AI ahoboaboa
readiness.subtitle: Nokware nhwɛ ho a wodi adwuma fa a mfiri-asetena tumi gye wɔ {country}, ne nimdeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ.
readiness.calibrationBody: Yɛtee Frey-Osborne mfiri-asetena nkyerɛkyerɛmu so {alphaPct}% sɛnea ɔman no nsesa-mu nkitahodie {infra} kyerɛ. Adwuma a ɛsesa biara hyɛ fam de {betaPct}% kaa ho.
readiness.adjacentSkillsHeading: Nimdeɛ a ɛbɛn a wobɛtumi anya

opportunities.title: Akwan a wobɛtumi anya
opportunities.subtitle: Nokware nhwɛ a egyina deɛ wotumi yɛ ɛnnɛ ne deɛ {country} adwuma akwan tua na wɔfa adwumayɛfoɔ so.
opportunities.noMatches: Yɛnhuu nokware nhyehyɛe biara — sɛ wode nimdeɛ pii ka wo profile ho a, ɛbɛboa.

dashboard.title: Amammuo dashboard — {country}
dashboard.subtitle: Mmofra adwuma akwan ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ mu. Yɛyɛɛ no maa nnwumakuo, ɛnyɛ dashboard kɛkɛ.
dashboard.neet: Mmabunu a wɔnni sukuu, adwuma anaa nteteeɛ mu (NEET)
dashboard.informality: Adwuma a ɛnni hɔ no fa
dashboard.gdpGrowth: GDP wɔ obi so nyini (afe biara %)
dashboard.skillSupplyDemand: Nimdeɛ ne adwuma fa hia ntam

constraints.lowBandwidthNotice: Yɛyɛɛ no ma ɛkɔ yie wɔ nkitahodie a ɛyɛ brɛoo ne nneɛma a nnipa pii de di dwuma so. Login nho hia.
